title: 第17章 他开始钓了半路却杀出个尤来亚-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》
content:
第(1/3)页

    秦夙这人，向来仗义。

    对保护和帮助过她的谢尘无是如此，见他要被关禁闭就敢闹起来。

    对给她安排星际通讯，耐心教导她的魏知弦，也该如此。

    “对，我来了！”她一拍胸脯，“有事尽管找我，别跟我客气！”

    魏知弦抬眸瞥她，略带揶揄，“真的？”

    秦夙又觉得自己有点飘了，不好意思的挠挠头，“我未必能帮你出什么靠谱的主意，只倾听行不行啊？当然，我还能鼓励鼓励你，尽量提供情绪价值。”

    这下魏知弦的笑意是真的藏不住了。

    头一次笑的那么明显，还对秦夙歪了下头，“那就，谢谢姐姐了。”

    哎哟不行，不行不行！

    秦夙脸一热，哪扛得住这种冷脸老师突然卖萌的转折！

    捂着心口里噗通噗通凌乱的跳动声。

    赶紧再找个别的话题，“我那个向导素啊，腺体啥的……还得发育多久？我什么时候能开始灵活运用向导素？”

    魏知弦注视着秦夙每一个小动作。

    她心跳加速了，他现在……也是。

    不着痕迹挑了下眉，魏知弦向窗外看一眼，“外面阳光正好，不如去塔后的公园里坐坐，我再继续给你讲。”

    后面几天，魏知弦几乎是寸步不离的继续在病房里照顾秦夙。

    尴尬又抽象的“姐弟相认”之后，这男人似乎真的不再端着架子。

    跟秦夙分享的第一件困扰，就是队伍里另外四个哨兵，真是各有各的性格，平时相处起来，根本不像其他小队那样团结和亲密。

    其中以离颂为首，对魏知弦来说，这位S级的队长是最难搞的一个。

    说离颂性格本来就有些孤僻阴郁，萧岑出事后更是变化无常，话都不跟队员多说。

    “可他还是能带领队员去污染区作战的，对吧？”秦夙听完了，才试着宽慰，“他只要还知道自己该做什么，会去做，就行了。你不能要求他如你所愿，做个战力超群，又面面俱到的完美队长。这其中还有另一种可能，他还是很依赖你这位魏老师，他知道他不管怎么任性，你都会给他兜底的。”

    魏知弦听了，苦笑一下，“这就是他成为队长后，立刻把我从学院调到他队里的最主要原因。让我给他兜底。”

    秦夙已经恢复很多力气，能自己走路了。

    她到沙发边拍拍魏知弦肩膀，“为师为长，你总会照顾着他的。而且你也乐在其中不是吗？”

    这番话，魏知弦从未跟别人聊起过。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Qin Su has always been a man of justice.

She didn’t do this to Xie Chen, who had protected and helped her, and she dared to make trouble when she saw that he was about to be imprisoned.

The same should be true for Wei Zhixian, who arranged interstellar communications for her and taught her patiently.

"Yes, I'm here!" She slapped her chest, "If you have any questions, just come to me, and don't be polite to me!"

Wei Zhixian raised his eyes and glanced at her, slightly teasing, "Really?"

Qin Su felt a little dizzy again and scratched his head in embarrassment, "I may not be able to help you with any reliable ideas. How about just listening? Of course, I can also encourage you and try to provide you with emotional value."

Now Wei Zhixian’s smile really couldn’t be hidden.

For the first time, he smiled so clearly and tilted his head to Qin Su, "Then, thank you, sister."

Ouch, no, no, no!

Qin Su’s face turned hot, how could he withstand the cold-faced teacher’s sudden cute turn!

Covering the chaotic beating sound in his heart.

Quickly find another topic, "My guide hormones, glands and so on... how long will it take to develop? When can I start to use guide hormones flexibly?"

Wei Zhixian watched Qin Su's every little move.

Her heartbeat accelerated, and so did he... now.

Wei Zhixian raised his eyebrows without any trace, and glanced out the window, "It's sunny outside, why don't you go sit in the park behind the tower, and I'll continue to tell you."

In the next few days, Wei Zhixian continued to take care of Qin Su in the ward almost every step of the way.

After the awkward and abstract "sister and brother recognition", this man seemed to really no longer put on airs.

The first trouble I shared with Qin Su was that the other four sentries in the team really had their own personalities. When they got along with each other, they were not as united and close as other teams.

Led by Li Song, this S-class captain is the most difficult one for Wei Zhixian.

It is said that Li Song’s character was somewhat withdrawn and gloomy to begin with. After Xiao Cen’s accident, he became even more erratic and did not say much to the team members.

"But he can still lead his team members to fight in contaminated areas, right?" Qin Su tried to comfort him after hearing this, "As long as he knows what he should do and can do it, that's all. You can't ask him to be a perfect captain with superior combat power and all-round skills as you want. There is another possibility. He still relies on you, Teacher Wei, and he knows that no matter how willful he is, you will protect him."

Wei Zhixian listened and smiled bitterly, "This is the main reason why he immediately transferred me from the academy to his team after he became the captain. Let me give him the cover."

Qin Su has recovered a lot of strength and can walk on his own.

She went to the sofa and patted Wei Zhixian on the shoulder, "As a teacher and a leader, you will always take care of him. And you also enjoy it, don't you?"

Wei Zhixian has never talked about these words with anyone else.
